rules.title: Statewide Rent Control Ballot Question
rules.requirement: A proposed ballot measure to limit annual rent increases across Massachusetts was struck down by the state's Supreme Judicial Court and cannot appear on the ballot.

coverage.summary: Statewide proposal covering residences with exemptions for certain categories including religious units.

rules.exemptions: Units operated solely for religious purposes and other specified exemptions.
rules.citation: Supreme Judicial Court ruling on November ballot question
rules.quoted_span: The state’s Supreme Judicial Court ruled a ballot question seeking to bring rent control back to Massachusetts cannot go forward this November, because it includes a religious exemption.
